Messages.Author: dabbler
Messages.Body:
I have been really getting updated on all the rules.

Does the vampire Sensory Deprivation is to be played on need to be tapped already? or can it be played on an untapped Vampire? If so and the vampire starts the turn untapped can't it take one last action?

Thanks in advance.. Great Site!

Dabbler

Messages.Author: D-dennis
Messages.Body:
At CHI the card can be played on any vampire, so also on an untapped one.

> Sensory Deprivation
> Action
> Chimerstry
> [3 Blood]
> [chi]  Burn any retainer or put this card on any ally. The minion with this card does not untap as normal during the untap phase as long as the acting vampire remains in play.
> [CHI] As above, but put this card on any vampire in play.
>
Sense dep only mentions not untapping as normal during the untap phase. So if you find a way of being untapped in other phases (mylan horseed for example) or a way to untap in another way than normal (infernal minions) sense dep is nothing more than a flesh wound to the vampire playing the card
While a minion with sense dep on is untapped, it can act as normal.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> dabbler wrote:
> Does the vampire Sensory Deprivation is to be played on need to be tapped already? or can it be played on an untapped Vampire? If so and the vampire starts the turn untapped can't it take one last action?
>
You can play it on an untapped vampire.
If that vampire is untapped, he can indeed perform one action (and, if he plays Freak Drive, a second one, etc.)

> dabbler wrote:
> So a Sensory Deprived Vamp (tapped) can still use Awake With Evening Freshness and play Telepathic Counters, if need be?
>
Yes. And even Sense the Savage Way, or Majesty.
Sensory Deprivation doesn't remove the ability to untap, it only removes the ability to untap as normal during your untap phase.
